What the claim record means

A settlement ratio is the share of claims an insurer paid in a year. It is the single most useful number about a company, and also the most easily misread: a high ratio on a small book says less than the same ratio on a large one, and it says nothing about how long a claim took or how hard it was to get paid. That is why we read it beside complaint volume — Niva Bupa draws 37.13 complaints per 10,000 claims — rather than on its own.

Both figures are fy 2024–26 (3-year average) from IRDAI Annual Report, insurer public disclosures & policy wordings. See how we score plans and insurers.
